# Incremental Reconciliation

This feature processes merged pull requests and direct commits after a defined watermark, allowing for efficient updates to the knowledge context without re-processing the entire repository.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
